title: leptolepia maxima
intro: Leptolepia maxima, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a species of tree fern native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Leptolepia maxima include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating conditions like bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
